paras.text: Here is a list of some common transitional devices that can be used to cue readers in a given way.
paras.urdu: یہاں کچھ عام عبوری ذرائع کی فہرست ہے جو قارئین کو کسی خاص سمت میں اشارہ دینے کے لیے استعمال کیے جا سکتے ہیں۔
paras.pashto: دلته د ځینو عامو انتقالي وسایلو لست دی چې لوستونکو ته په یوه ټاکلي ډول د اشارې لپاره کارول کېدای شي.

paras.text: TO ADD:
paras.urdu: اضافہ کے لیے:

paras.text: and, again, and then, besides, equally important, finally, further, furthermore, nor, too, next, lastly, what's more, moreover, in addition, first (second, etc.)

paras.text: TO COMPARE:
paras.urdu: موازنہ کے لیے:
paras.pashto: د پرتلې لپاره:

paras.text: whereas, but, yet, on the other hand, however, nevertheless, on the contrary, by comparison, where, compared to, up against, balanced against, vis a vis, but, although, conversely, meanwhile, after all, in contrast, although this may be true, etc.
paras.urdu: whereas, but, yet, on the other hand, however, nevertheless, on the contrary, by comparison, where, compared to, up against, balanced against, vis a vis, but, although, conversely, meanwhile, after all, in contrast, although this may be true, etc.

paras.text: TO PROVE:
paras.urdu: ثابت کرنے کے لیے:

paras.urdu: وقت ظاہر کرنے کے لیے:
paras.pashto: د وخت د ښودلو لپاره:

paras.pashto: A. تش ځایونه په بکس کې د ورکړل شویو بېلابېلو ډولونو د مناسب انتقالي کلمې/عبارت سره ډک کړئ

paras.text: 1. ________, the teachers were meeting in a closed-door session. (place and space)
paras.urdu: 1. ________، اساتذہ ایک بند کمرے کے اجلاس میں مصروف تھے۔ (جگہ اور مقام)
paras.pashto: 1. ________، ښوونکي په یوه تړلې غونډه کې وو. (ځای او فضا)

paras.text: 2. ________, the harvest dance was also held on a Friday night. (comparison / contrast)
paras.urdu: 2. ________، فصل کی کٹائی کا رقص بھی جمعہ کی رات منعقد ہوا۔ (موازنہ / تقابل)
paras.pashto: 2. ________، د حاصل د رېبلو نڅا هم د جمعې په شپه وشوه. (پرتله / توپیر)

paras.text: 3. ________ the school district pays for half of the students' breakfasts, there still will be those without enough resources to pay for the remaining amount. (cause / purpose)
paras.urdu: 3. ________ اسکول ڈسٹرکٹ طلبہ کے آدھے ناشتے کی ادائیگی کرتا ہے، پھر بھی ایسے لوگ ہوں گے جن کے پاس باقی رقم ادا کرنے کے لیے کافی وسائل نہیں ہوں گے۔ (سبب / مقصد)
paras.pashto: 3. ________ د ښوونځي ولسوالي د زده کوونکو د نیمایي ناري پیسې ورکوي، بیا به هم داسې کسان وي چې د پاتې پیسو د ورکولو لپاره کافي سرچینې نه لري. (لامل / موخه)

paras.text: 4. ________, no one has more influence on a student 's grades than the student himself. (conclusion / summary)
paras.urdu: 4. ________، کسی طالب علم کے نمبروں پر خود طالب علم سے زیادہ کسی کا اثر نہیں ہوتا۔ (نتیجہ / خلاصہ)
paras.pashto: 4. ________، د یوه زده کوونکي پر نمرو هېڅوک تر پخپله زده کوونکي ډېر اغېز نه لري. (پایله / لنډیز)

paras.text: 5. ________, the library will be closed during lunch. (time / sequence)
paras.urdu: 5. ________، دوپہر کے کھانے کے دوران لائبریری بند رہے گی۔ (وقت / ترتیب)
paras.pashto: 5. ________، د غرمې ډوډۍ پر مهال کتابتون به تړلی وي. (وخت / ترتیب)

paras.text: 6. ________, fewer students are able to take courses in the fine arts: music, art, and drama. (effect / result / qualification)
paras.urdu: 6. ________، کم طلبہ فنونِ لطیفہ: موسیقی، مصوری اور ڈراما کے کورسز لے پاتے ہیں۔ (اثر / نتیجہ / شرط)
paras.pashto: 6. ________، لږ زده کوونکي وکولای شي په ښکلو هنرونو: موسیقۍ، هنر او ډرامې کې کورسونه واخلي. (اغېز / پایله / شرط)

paras.text: 7. ________, the student council has unanimously endorsed the revised calendar for the school. (addition / extension)
paras.urdu: 7. ________، طلبہ کونسل نے اسکول کے نظرِ ثانی شدہ کیلنڈر کی متفقہ توثیق کر دی ہے۔ (اضافہ / توسیع)
paras.pashto: 7. ________، د زده کوونکو شورا د ښوونځي بیاکتل شوې جنتري په اتفاق تایید کړې. (زیاتوالی / پراختیا)

paras.text: 8. ________, a longer school day may provide more opportunities instead of fewer. (example /clarification/ emphasis )
paras.urdu: 8. ________، اسکول کا طویل دن کم کے بجائے زیادہ مواقع فراہم کر سکتا ہے۔ (مثال / وضاحت / تاکید)
paras.pashto: 8. ________، د ښوونځي اوږده ورځ کېدای شي د لږو پر ځای ډېر فرصتونه برابر کړي. (بېلګه / روښانتیا / ټینګار)

paras.pashto: 1. ټیم په ازموینه کې A وګاټه؛ ________، جسټن هم A ترلاسه کړ.

paras.text: 2. The book was interesting; ________, it was hard to read.
paras.urdu: 2. کتاب دلچسپ تھی؛ ________، اسے پڑھنا مشکل تھا۔
paras.pashto: 2. کتاب زړه‌راښکونکی و؛ ________، لوستل یې سخت وو.

paras.text: 3. Gordon finished his chores early; ________, he had time to play football.
paras.urdu: 3. گورڈن نے اپنے کام جلدی ختم کر لیے؛ ________، اس کے پاس فٹ بال کھیلنے کا وقت تھا۔
paras.pashto: 3. ګورډن خپل کارونه ژر بشپړ کړل؛ ________، د فوټبال لوبې لپاره یې وخت درلود.

paras.text: 4. Sarah's horse is beautiful; ________, it is well-bred.
paras.urdu: 4. سارہ کا گھوڑا خوبصورت ہے؛ ________، یہ اچھی نسل کا ہے۔
paras.pashto: 4. د سارې آس ښکلی دی؛ ________، ښه نسل لري.

paras.text: 5. The sailors prepared the ship to sail; ________, the dock workers loaded the cargo.
paras.urdu: 5. ملاحوں نے جہاز کو روانگی کے لیے تیار کیا؛ ________، گودی کے مزدوروں نے سامان لادا۔
paras.pashto: 5. ملاحانو بېړۍ د تګ لپاره چمتو کړه؛ ________، د بندر کارګرانو بار بار کړ.

paras.text: 6. Her sister had a cold; ________, Julie's family canceled the trip.
paras.urdu: 6. اس کی بہن کو زکام تھا؛ ________، جولی کے خاندان نے سفر منسوخ کر دیا۔
paras.pashto: 6. خور یې زکام وه؛ ________، د جولي کورنۍ سفر لغوه کړ.

paras.text: 7. Oranges are good for you; ________, they are full of vitamin C.
paras.urdu: 7. مالٹے آپ کے لیے مفید ہیں؛ ________، ان میں وٹامن سی بھرپور ہے۔
paras.pashto: 7. مالټې ستاسو لپاره ګټورې دي؛ ________، له ویټامین C ډکې دي.

paras.text: 8. Two seats were left on the bus; ________, most of the group had to wait for the next one.
paras.urdu: 8. بس میں دو نشستیں باقی تھیں؛ ________، گروہ کے زیادہ تر افراد کو اگلی بس کا انتظار کرنا پڑا۔
paras.pashto: 8. په بس کې دوه څوکۍ پاتې وې؛ ________، د ډلې ډېری غړي اړ شول چې د بل انتظار وکړي.

sections.theory:
Here is a list of some common transitional devices that can be used to cue readers in a given way.

TO ADD:

and, again, and then, besides, equally important, finally, further, furthermore, nor, too, next, lastly, what's more, moreover, in addition, first (second, etc.)

TO COMPARE:

whereas, but, yet, on the other hand, however, nevertheless, on the contrary, by comparison, where, compared to, up against, balanced against, vis a vis, but, although, conversely, meanwhile, after all, in contrast, although this may be true, etc.

TO PROVE:

because, for, since, for the same reason, obviously, evidently, furthermore, moreover, besides, indeed, in fact, in addition, in any case, that is, etc.

TO SHOW EXCEPTION:

yet, still, however, nevertheless, in spite of, despite, of course, once in a while, sometimes,etc.

TO SHOW TIME:

immediately, thereafter, soon, after a few hours, finally, then, later, previously, formerly, first (second, etc.), next, and then, etc.

TO REPEAT:

in brief, as I have said, as I have noted, as has been noted, etc.

TO EMPHASIZE:

definitely, extremely, obviously, in fact, indeed, in any case, absolutely, positively, naturally, surprisingly, always, forever, perennially, eternally, never, emphatically, unquestionably, without a doubt, certainly, undeniably, without reservation, etc.

TO SHOW SEQUENCE:

first, second, third, and so forth. A, B, C, and so forth. next, then, following this, at this time, now, at this point, after, afterward, subsequently, finally, consequently, previously, before this, simultaneously, concurrently, thus, therefore, hence, next, and then, soon, etc.

TO GIVE AN EXAMPLE:

for example, for instance, in this case, in another case, on this occasion, in this situation, take the case of, to demonstrate, to illustrate, as an illustration, to illustrate, etc.

TO SUMMARIZE OR CONCLUDE:

in brief, on the whole, summing up, to conclude, in conclusion, as I have shown, as I have said, hence, therefore, accordingly, thus, as a result, consequently, etc.

Activity

A. Fill in the blanks with appropriate transitional word/phrase of different types given in the box

nearby, similarly, even if, ultimately, in the meantime, consequently, furthermore, in other words

1. ________, the teachers were meeting in a closed-door session. (place and space)

2. ________, the harvest dance was also held on a Friday night. (comparison / contrast)

3. ________ the school district pays for half of the students' breakfasts, there still will be those without enough resources to pay for the remaining amount. (cause / purpose)

4. ________, no one has more influence on a student 's grades than the student himself. (conclusion / summary)

5. ________, the library will be closed during lunch. (time / sequence)

6. ________, fewer students are able to take courses in the fine arts: music, art, and drama. (effect / result / qualification)

7. ________, the student council has unanimously endorsed the revised calendar for the school. (addition / extension)

8. ________, a longer school day may provide more opportunities instead of fewer. (example /clarification/ emphasis )

B. Use the correct transition words in the blank spaces below from list of transition words in the box.

therefore, for example, consequently, meanwhile, likewise, although

1. Tim earned an A on the test; ________,Justin also received an A.

2. The book was interesting; ________, it was hard to read.

3. Gordon finished his chores early; ________, he had time to play football.

4. Sarah's horse is beautiful; ________, it is well-bred.

5. The sailors prepared the ship to sail; ________, the dock workers loaded the cargo.

6. Her sister had a cold; ________, Julie's family canceled the trip.

7. Oranges are good for you; ________, they are full of vitamin C.

8. Two seats were left on the bus; ________, most of the group had to wait for the next one.

sections.content:
Here is a list of some common transitional devices that can be used to cue readers in a given way.

TO ADD:

and, again, and then, besides, equally important, finally, further, furthermore, nor, too, next, lastly, what's more, moreover, in addition, first (second, etc.)

TO COMPARE:

whereas, but, yet, on the other hand, however, nevertheless, on the contrary, by comparison, where, compared to, up against, balanced against, vis a vis, but, although, conversely, meanwhile, after all, in contrast, although this may be true, etc.

TO PROVE:

because, for, since, for the same reason, obviously, evidently, furthermore, moreover, besides, indeed, in fact, in addition, in any case, that is, etc.

TO SHOW EXCEPTION:

yet, still, however, nevertheless, in spite of, despite, of course, once in a while, sometimes,etc.

TO SHOW TIME:

immediately, thereafter, soon, after a few hours, finally, then, later, previously, formerly, first (second, etc.), next, and then, etc.

TO REPEAT:

in brief, as I have said, as I have noted, as has been noted, etc.

TO EMPHASIZE:

definitely, extremely, obviously, in fact, indeed, in any case, absolutely, positively, naturally, surprisingly, always, forever, perennially, eternally, never, emphatically, unquestionably, without a doubt, certainly, undeniably, without reservation, etc.

TO SHOW SEQUENCE:

first, second, third, and so forth. A, B, C, and so forth. next, then, following this, at this time, now, at this point, after, afterward, subsequently, finally, consequently, previously, before this, simultaneously, concurrently, thus, therefore, hence, next, and then, soon, etc.

TO GIVE AN EXAMPLE:

for example, for instance, in this case, in another case, on this occasion, in this situation, take the case of, to demonstrate, to illustrate, as an illustration, to illustrate, etc.

TO SUMMARIZE OR CONCLUDE:

in brief, on the whole, summing up, to conclude, in conclusion, as I have shown, as I have said, hence, therefore, accordingly, thus, as a result, consequently, etc.

Activity

A. Fill in the blanks with appropriate transitional word/phrase of different types given in the box

nearby, similarly, even if, ultimately, in the meantime, consequently, furthermore, in other words

1. ________, the teachers were meeting in a closed-door session. (place and space)

2. ________, the harvest dance was also held on a Friday night. (comparison / contrast)

3. ________ the school district pays for half of the students' breakfasts, there still will be those without enough resources to pay for the remaining amount. (cause / purpose)

4. ________, no one has more influence on a student 's grades than the student himself. (conclusion / summary)

5. ________, the library will be closed during lunch. (time / sequence)

6. ________, fewer students are able to take courses in the fine arts: music, art, and drama. (effect / result / qualification)

7. ________, the student council has unanimously endorsed the revised calendar for the school. (addition / extension)

8. ________, a longer school day may provide more opportunities instead of fewer. (example /clarification/ emphasis )

B. Use the correct transition words in the blank spaces below from list of transition words in the box.

therefore, for example, consequently, meanwhile, likewise, although

1. Tim earned an A on the test; ________,Justin also received an A.

2. The book was interesting; ________, it was hard to read.
